notes.note: Column header of the leases and the history: the address family of the row (DHCPv4 or DHCPv6).
Column header of the leases: what the lease holds, an address or a delegated prefix.
Column header of the leases and the history: the DUID of a DHCPv6 client (RFC 8415).
Column header of the leases: the lease of the same client in the other address family.
What a lease holds: a single address (DHCPv4, and the non-temporary addresses of DHCPv6).
What a lease holds: a delegated prefix of DHCPv6 prefix delegation.
The identity association of a DHCPv6 lease, under its DUID; {iaid} is the number.
Before the address of the client's lease in the other family, in the leases list; {family} is DHCPv4 or DHCPv6.
Tooltip of the link to the client's lease in the other family; {family} is DHCPv4 or DHCPv6, {state} the binding state of that lease.

segment.source: Show the {family} lease of this client ({state})

notes.note: Label of the filter that chooses the address family of the leases or the history.
The entry of the family filter that shows both families.
Label of the filter for the DUID of a DHCPv6 client.
Example in the DUID filter: a DUID-LL over an example MAC address.
Shown under the DUID filter when its text is no DUID.

segment.source: That is not a DUID: use hexadecimal digits in pairs, with or without colons.
segment.target: Det är inget DUID: använd hexadecimala siffror i par, med eller utan kolon.

notes.note: Body of the release dialog for a DHCPv6 lease whose client has no known MAC address; {addr} is the address, {duid} the DUID of the client.

segment.source: The lease of {addr} held by the client with the DUID {duid} ends now. The client can ask for an address again.
segment.target: Lånet på {addr} som klienten med DUID {duid} håller slutar nu. Klienten kan be om en adress igen.

notes.note: Fact in the status strip of the DHCP role: the listeners of both families; {v4} and {v6} are the numbers.
Fact in the status strip of the DHCP role: the scopes of both families; {v4} and {v6} are the numbers.
Fact in the status strip of the DHCP role: the active leases of both families; {v4} and {v6} are the formatted numbers.
Tooltip of the count of leases in one state when both families have leases; {v4} and {v6} are the formatted numbers.
Before the DUID a DHCPv6 reservation is keyed by, on the host page.
Shown instead of the identity of a DHCPv6 reservation when the interface has neither a DUID nor a MAC address.

segment.source: No DUID or MAC address: no reservation
segment.target: Ingen DUID eller MAC-adress: ingen reservation
